calls.title: Onboarding Progress Sync
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the SDK onboarding script, which runs a setup wizard to assist users with feature flags and metrics detection while introducing a new OAuth login flow. Participants discussed the creation of a feature flag and attributes page that currently lacks product integration and needs a delete/revert option. There was an emphasis on creating separate onboarding flows for engineers and data scientists, with a suggestion for an escape hatch to allow users to skip steps. Metrics auto-detection via AI or codebase scans was desired, along with consistency across SDK connection flows. Next steps included collaborating with a designer to refine the onboarding flow and reviewing PostHog's modal onboarding for further inspiration.
calls.keywords: onboarding, SDK connection, feature flag, onboarding flow, AI automation, user authentication
